brief.title: Feathers Over the Mist
brief.premise: A disowned sword-student must carry her late master's tally-stick to three rival sects to call a peace moot, before the island clans' feud burns the last crane rookeries.
constraints: Duels are settled by formal challenge, never ambush.

world.name: The Crane Banner Coast
world.description: A mist-bound coast of rocky islets where martial sects hold fishing rights under an old dueling covenant, and the cranes that nest in the rookeries are counted as omens by every school.

locations.name: The Mist Rookery
locations.description: Crane nesting islets whose shallows hold the richest eel grounds on the coast.

locations.name: Bannerhall
locations.description: The hall where challenges are recorded beneath the Crane Banner pact.

locations.name: Saltmarket Isle
locations.description: A neutral trade isle where envoys may meet under the market peace.

locations.name: Thunder Reed Dojo
locations.description: A weathered school built in the reed marshes, where the tally-stick's late keeper taught.

factions.name: The Crane Sect
factions.description: Keepers of the dueling covenant, who witness every formal challenge at Bannerhall.

factions.name: The Eel School
factions.description: An aggressive school claiming ancestral fishing rights to the rookery shallows.

factions.name: The Salt Wardens
factions.description: Neutral market wardens who guarantee safe conduct for envoys on Saltmarket Isle.

rules.statement: No blade may be drawn between sects except after a formal challenge witnessed at Bannerhall.
No nets may be cast within sight of the Mist Rookery while the cranes are nesting.
A master's tally-stick, once presented, obliges every sect named on it to send an envoy to the moot.
The light-body art lets a trained adept run across reeds, rigging and rooftops, but never over open water.

history.name: The Net Wars
history.description: Sects feuded over the rookery shallows until the eel grounds were nearly fished out.

history.name: The Broken Challenge
history.description: An ambush disguised as a formal duel nearly destroyed the covenant and the market peace.

history.name: The First Banner
history.description: The sects swore the Crane Banner pact at Bannerhall and ended the Net Wars.

conflicts.name: The Rookery Rights
conflicts.description: The Eel School presses its claim to fish the rookery shallows while the Crane Sect holds the nesting ban.

conflicts.name: The Unanswered Tally
conflicts.description: The sects are deadlocked over whether a tally-stick carried by a disowned student still binds them.

evidence_summary: The world, cast and storyboard satisfy the brief's crane-and-covenant wuxia setting; deterministic validators are clean and there are no blocking defects.
